title: 第14章 虎击第15章 不堪一击

第014章 虎击
过了一会儿，忽然起风了。原本明朗的天空也阴沉了下来。丝丝的冷风，吹在唐安的面孔上。
唐安抬头望了一眼天空，天空已经有些暗下来了，不出意外，一场小雪在所难免。
唐安内气已成，冷暖不惧，倒是不怕冷。不过身体血液因为温度降低，缓了下来。倒是真的。感觉到身体有一丝的不灵活，唐安内气一转，全身立马就开始释放出热量，瞬间就驱除了冷意。
“嘭！”
就在这时，擂台上又有一人掉了下来。
今天的比斗已经数不清到底有多少人从擂台上被人打下来了。这也说明，这次比斗的程度有多么惨烈。谁都不想输，当然谁都不会认输。不想输，就只能把对手打下来！
唐安站在场边，这是第二轮的比斗了，前面两人都已经赢了，唐安是第三对上场的。
“28号唐安，上场！”
听到这个声音，唐安随手将衣服一脱，脚上猛的一蹬，也不走那台阶，直接一跃而起，瞬间跳上了1米多高的擂台。
他的对手看到唐安的这个动作，脸色明显抽了一下，脸一下子就涨红了，愤怒！唐安这个动作明显是在挑衅他。
“可恶，你居然敢小瞧我！”
唐安看到对方的眼神不善，也不理会。刚才那人在台上比斗的时候，他一直就在底下仔细观察。甲字号擂台，除了王锋，他发现居然没有一人是自己的对手。
唐安不知道，其实经过小培元丹的改善，他的体质已经极好了，再加上敏捷顶峰的天赋，他已经算是这一代弟子里的佼佼者了。又加上他修炼刻苦，如今这里所有人的实力，他基本都看得清清楚楚。
对面这个人，他一看就知道，不是自己的对手！
“铛！”
一声锣鼓，宣告比斗正式开始！
一瞬间，唐安的气势就变了！
他伏下身子，双目死死盯着对手，那腾腾的杀机让对的毛孔一下子就收缩了起来，额头更是滑过一丝冷汗。就连心中也不自觉的害怕了。
他看着唐安的眼神，一阵心悸：“他到底想做什么，难道他真的想杀我吗？为什么杀机这么重！”

唐安的肩膀一动，脚上猛的踏在了地上，只听“咚”的一声，只看到一道光芒瞬间朝对方扑去。
他冲到了对手身前一步，忽然猛的跳起身来，他的对手甚至只来得及抬起双手格挡，脚下想动却是怎么也动不了！
唐安的速度太快了！快的让他都来不及反应！
“虎击！”
唐安猛的跳起来，膝盖到了那人的头顶高度之后，便猛的将身子下潜。那一瞬间，他的膝盖唰的就抬了起来。以迅雷不及掩耳之势撞向对手！
“嘭！”
一声脆响，唐安的膝盖重重的撞击在对方的手臂之上，在撞击的瞬间，所有人都看得清清楚楚，唐安的双手猛地伸出，直接抓住了对方的肩胛骨，将对方的肩胛骨捏的严严实实的。
“吼！”
唐安大叫一声，手上猛的一用力，手指如同镔铁一样深深的抓进了对手的肩膀。
所有人都听到了一声惨绝人寰的尖叫。
之后，那人的双手便被唐安的膝盖重击了一下，又加上唐安捏住了他的关节，他的手臂顿时无力的垂了下来！
可是唐安的人却还在半空，膝盖被阻挡了一下，虽然威力减半，可是他猛地在半空中踢出一腿，而脚尖恰好对准了对手的腹部！
“嘭！”
这一击踢腿，脚尖直奔对方腹部胃头剑突位置。
顿时，那人就感觉到一阵剧痛从胃部传来，眼前更是一阵发黑，就眼珠子都快翻白了。
他捂着腹部，剧烈的疼痛让他的身子直接弓成了虾米形状，人也站不住了，整个人就缩在地上不停地打颤，嘴角开始不停地吐着白沫。
唐安踢完之后，却是轻松的翻了一个身子又退回到远处，慢悠悠的弯下身子，将自己扔在擂台上的衣服又缓缓的披在了身上。这一切做的风轻云淡，就像是做了一件极其普通的事。
底下的很多人都还在发愣，甚至还有人才刚刚回过头去喊同伴过来看比赛，可是等回过头来，就看到一个人躺在地上发颤，另一个已经从台上下来了。那人不禁有些傻眼的问旁边的人：“已经结束了？这么快？”
旁边的那人也在发愣，被拍了几下，才喃喃说道：“好，好厉害……”
从刚刚的进攻到最后结束，唐安居然只用了短短的几秒钟！

不动则已，一动则如山崩地裂，猛虎下山！
那一种锐不可当的势，仿佛任何挡在唐安的前面人，都会被他那一下虎击给硬挡生生击碎。
气势，霸道无双！
看到那人的痛苦模样，底下有不少小屁孩都闭着眼睛不敢再看。
太残酷了，原来这简单的门内比斗就已经如此残酷了。那等到真正的行走江湖时，又该是怎么样的情形呢？他们想到这里，脑中不禁问自己：“江湖这条路，我还要不要继续走？”
不过旁边那两个个见惯了血雨腥风的内门弟子，看到唐安那干净利索的动作，却是猛地拍了一下桌子站起来大吼：“好！！好！打的好！”喊完后才发现情况有些不对劲，这可不是江湖比斗，而是自己蜀山门内的选拔比斗啊。而且，自己貌似还是裁判~
他看到小屁孩们的奇怪眼神，赶忙掩饰了一下，咳嗽一声：“下一场！快！别磨蹭！”
唐安的霸道，王锋的狠厉，这就是一号擂台的一切！
其他人比起他们两人来说，差距太大了。
或许他们在境界上都已经到了天人第二重，可是在气势上，临场发挥上，却是大大的不如这两人。
那两个内门弟子，看别人比斗的时候也都是懒懒散撒的，可是一轮到唐安和王锋的比斗，两人就瞪着眼睛想仔细看看这两个小师弟能给自己带来什么惊喜。
“王锋，那是【赤金剑】王首座的儿子，家学渊源，比之这些普通的弟子强上几分那也很正常。可是另一个唐安，我却一丝印象也没有。这两人到目前为之，应该是还没有使出全力。到底谁会赢得最后的比斗呢？”那内门弟子想到这里，忽然轻笑了一声，摇摇头：“想不到我堂堂天人五重境的江湖一流高手，居然在关心小屁孩之间的比斗，真是不可思议。”
他旁边那位似乎是听到了自己师弟的话，跟着说道：“不仅是你，连你师兄我也有些好奇呢。不过这也不奇怪，他们打的越是精彩，咱们蜀山的未来可就越光辉，咱们做师兄的，心里自然也高兴。当然也就会憧憬他们未来到底能走多远。”
那人听了，顿时大笑：“师兄说的在理。咱们确实不用关心谁输谁赢。这两个小家伙，进内门是迟早的。不过咱们还是需要注意，等下这两人若是遇到了，激斗之间，难免受伤，咱们可得看紧了，不要让他们受了重伤，影响未来的成就了。”
那师兄听到这里也微微点头：“那是自然。”
content_en:
Chapter 014 Tiger Attack
After a while, the wind suddenly picked up. The originally bright sky also became gloomy. A bit of cold wind blew on Tang An's face.
Tang An raised his head and glanced at the sky. The sky had become a little dark. As expected, a light snowfall was inevitable.
Tang An's internal energy has been established and he is not afraid of warmth or cold, but he is not afraid of cold. However, the blood in the body slowed down due to the lower temperature. It's true. Feeling a little inflexible in his body, Tang An's inner energy turned, and his whole body immediately began to release heat, instantly driving away the coldness.
"Bang!"
At this moment, another person fell off the ring.
In today's competition, I can't count how many people were knocked off the ring. This also shows how brutal the competition was. No one wants to lose, and of course no one will admit defeat. If you don’t want to lose, you have to defeat your opponent!
Tang An stood on the sidelines. This was the second round of the competition. Both of the previous two had won. Tang An was the third pair to play.
"No. 28 Tang An, come on!"
Hearing this voice, Tang An casually took off his clothes, kicked his feet fiercely, and jumped up directly without taking the steps, instantly jumping onto the 1-meter-high ring.
When his opponent saw Tang An's action, his face twitched obviously, and his face suddenly turned red and angry! Tang An's action was obviously provoking him.
"Damn it, you actually dare to look down on me!"
Tang An saw the unkind look in the other person's eyes and ignored him. When the man was competing on the stage just now, he had been observing carefully from below. In the A-size arena, except for Wang Feng, he found that no one was his opponent.
Tang An didn't know that after the improvement of Xiao Pei Yuan Dan, his physique was already excellent. Coupled with his peak agility talent, he was already considered the leader among this generation of disciples. Coupled with his hard training, he can now clearly see the strength of everyone here.
He knew at a glance that the person opposite him was no match for him!
"Cang!"
A sound of gongs and drums announced that the competition has officially begun!
In an instant, Tang An's momentum changed!
He leaned down and stared at his opponent with his eyes fixed on him. The fierce murderous intent made his opponent's pores shrink immediately, and a trace of cold sweat slid down his forehead. Even my heart was unconsciously afraid.
He looked at Tang An's eyes, and his heart palpitated: "What exactly does he want to do? Does he really want to kill me? Why is the murderous intention so serious!"
Tang An's shoulders moved and his feet slammed on the ground. He heard a "dong" sound and saw a ray of light rushing towards the opponent instantly.
He rushed one step in front of his opponent and suddenly jumped up. His opponent only had time to raise his hands to block, but he couldn't move his feet even if he wanted to move!
Tang An's speed is too fast! So fast that he had no time to react!
"Tiger Strike!"
Tang An jumped up suddenly, and after his knees reached the height of the man's head, he dived down fiercely. At that moment, his knees suddenly lifted up. Crash into the opponent with lightning speed!
"Bang!"
With a crisp sound, Tang An's knee hit the opponent's arm hard. At the moment of impact, everyone could see clearly that Tang An's hands suddenly stretched out and directly grabbed the opponent's shoulder blades, pinching the opponent's shoulder blades tightly.
"Roar!"
Tang An yelled, and with a strong force on his hand, his fingers dug into his opponent's shoulder like iron.
Everyone heard a horrific scream.
After that, the man's hands were hit hard by Tang An's knee, and Tang An pinched his joints, and his arms suddenly hung down weakly!
But Tang An was still in mid-air, and his knee was blocked. Although the power was reduced by half, he suddenly kicked out in mid-air, and his toe was aimed at the opponent's abdomen!
"Bang!"
This blow kicks the leg,The toes go straight to the xiphoid process of the stomach head of the opponent's abdomen.
Immediately, the man felt a sharp pain coming from his stomach, and his eyes turned black for a while, and his eyes almost turned white.
He clutched his abdomen, and the severe pain caused his body to bend into the shape of a shrimp. He could no longer stand. He huddled on the ground and trembled constantly, and foam began to pour out of the corners of his mouth.
After Tang An finished the kick, he easily turned over and retreated back to the distance. He slowly bent down and slowly put the clothes he had thrown on the ring around him. All this was done calmly, as if it was an extremely ordinary thing.
Many people below were still in a daze, and some even just turned around to call their companions to come over and watch the game. But when they turned around, they saw one person lying on the ground trembling, and the other had already come down from the stage. The man couldn't help but asked the person next to him dumbfounded: "It's over already? So soon?"
The man next to him was also in a daze. After being patted a few times, he murmured: "Okay, so awesome..."
From the attack just now to the end, Tang An actually only took a few seconds!
If you don't move, it will be over. If you move, it will be like a mountain falling apart and a tiger descending from the mountain!
It was such an unstoppable momentum that anyone standing in front of Tang An would be crushed by his tiger attack.
Momentum, unparalleled dominance!
Seeing the man's painful appearance, many little kids below closed their eyes and did not dare to look any further.
It's so cruel. It turns out that this simple internal competition is already so cruel. So what will it be like when you actually travel the world? Thinking of this, they couldn't help but ask themselves: "Should I continue on this road of Jianghu?"
However, the two inner sect disciples next to them who were used to seeing blood and blood, saw Tang An's clean and neat movements, but they slammed the table and stood up and shouted: "Okay!! Okay! Good fight!" After shouting, they realized that something was wrong. This was not a competition between rivers and lakes, but a selection competition within the Shushan sect. Moreover, he seems to be a referee~
Seeing the strange looks from the little brats, he hurriedly covered it up and coughed: "Next game! Hurry! Don't wait!"
Tang An's domineering, Wang Feng's ruthlessness, this is everything in Arena No. 1!
Compared to the two of them, the gap between the others is too big.
Perhaps they have reached the second level of heavenly realm, but in terms of momentum and on-the-spot performance, they are far inferior to these two.
The two inner disciples were lazy when watching others compete, but when it came to the competition between Tang An and Wang Feng, the two of them stared to see carefully what surprises these two junior disciples could bring to them.
"Wang Feng, that is the son of the leader of the [Red Gold Sword] King. He has a good family background. It is normal for him to be a little better than these ordinary disciples. But I have no impression of the other Tang An. These two people have not used their full strength for this so far. Who will win the final battle?" Thinking of this, the inner disciple suddenly chuckled and shook his head: "I didn't expect that a master of the fifth level of heaven and earth would actually care about the battle between little brats. It's incredible."
The person next to him seemed to have heard his junior brother's words, and then said: "Not only you, but also your senior brother, I am also a little curious. But this is not surprising. The more exciting they play, the brighter the future of our Shushan. As senior brothers, we are naturally happy in our hearts. Of course, we will also look forward to how far they can go in the future."
After hearing this, the man burst into laughter: "Senior brother is right. We really don't need to care about who wins or loses. These two little guys will enter the inner gate sooner or later. But we still need to pay attention. If these two people meet later, they will inevitably be injured during the fierce fight. We have to be careful and don't let them get seriously injured, which will affect the future.Achieved. "
The senior brother nodded slightly when he heard this: "That's natural. "
